general.summary: The number of cyberattacks spiked in 2020 and has remained elevated since, posing a threat to the businesses, infrastructure, and critical systems we depend on. Experts say AI has played a role in both accelerating attacks and defending against them, but it gives criminals the upper hand. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Chile Central Bank Chief Says Economic Recovery May Take Longer
general.summary: Chile’s economic recovery could take longer as there are no clear signs yet that investment is bouncing back, central bank Governor Rosanna Costa said in an interview with El Mercurio published on Sunday.
